basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with interests in LLM Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning, Hallucination in Vision-Language Models, and LLM Truthfulness and Interpretability.

work.name: Tencent WXG

work.name: Shanghai AI Lab
work.summary: Research Intern (June 2023 - December 2023). Advised by Prof. Yu Cheng.
